title: N -W F P Local Government Second Amendment Ordinance 2001

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Local Government Second Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE LOCAL GOVERNMENT
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE LOCAL GOVERNMENT
(SECOND AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XXX OF 2001
An Ordinance
further to amend the North-West Frontier Local Government Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary, 27th October, 2001]
No. 1egis.1(18)70 Vol. IX,
dated 27-10-2001.---The following Ordinance by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for general information.
1. Short title and
commencement, ---(1) This Ordinance may be called the North-West Frontier
Province Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.description:
Amendment of Schedules to N.-W.F.P. Ord. No. XIV of 2001

NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE LOCAL GOVERNMENT
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE LOCAL GOVERNMENT
(SECOND AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XXX OF 2001
An Ordinance
further to amend the North-West Frontier Local Government Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary, 27th October, 2001]
No. 1egis.1(18)70 Vol. IX,
dated 27-10-2001.---The following Ordinance by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for general information.
2. Amendment of Schedules to
N.-W.F.P. Ord. No. XIV of 2001.- In the North-West Frontier Province Local
Government Ordinance, 2001 (N.-W.F.P. Ord. No. XIV of 2001),--
(a)
in the First Schedule, in Part B, for the existing entry at serial No.(vi), the
following shall be substituted,
namely:
"(iv)
Legal aid and drafting of Bye-Laws."; and
(b)
in the Fifth Schedule,--
(i)
in Part I (Rules), the entry at serial No.2 shall be deleted; and
(ii)
in Part II (Bye-Laws), for the existing entry at serial No.1, the following
shall be substituted, namely:
"1.
Local Government (Conduct of Business and Conduct of Meetings)."
